title: 2026-11-25_Xbash_Ransomware_Investigation_f8c
description: Investigate a ransomware attack on a victim machine and identify key indicators of compromise.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The victim machine was attacked by the ransomware. The attackers encrypted some files and left the ransom note behind. Investigate the victim machine to identify the C2 server port number.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
To access the victim machine, use the following credentials:

Hostname: victim
Username: cyrano
Password: cyrano

Type 'start' to proceed to the next level.
levels.local_content:
To access the victim machine locally, use the following credentials:

Hostname: victim
Username: cyrano
Password: cyrano

Type 'start' to proceed to the next level.

levels.title: C2 Server Communication Port Discovery
levels.content: The victim machine was attacked by the ransomware. The attackers encrypted some files and left the ransom note behind. Read this note and identify the C2 server port number.
levels.solution:
1. SSH into the victim machine using the provided credentials.
   ```
   ssh cyrano@192.168.90.10
   ```
2. Navigate to the home directory of the user.
   ```
   cd /home/cyrano
   ```
3. Read the ransom note file.
   ```
   cat RANSOM_NOTE.txt
   ```
4. Identify the C2 server port number mentioned in the ransom note.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Use the `cat` command to read the contents of the ransom note file.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for the line in the ransom note that mentions connecting to the C2 server.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: The port number is specified after the C2 server address in the ransom note.

levels.title: Identification of the Ransomware Script
levels.content: The attacker left the ransomware script describing different steps performed by the ransomware malware. Identify this script.
levels.solution:
1. SSH into the victim machine using the provided credentials.
   ```
   ssh cyrano@192.168.90.10
   ```
2. Navigate to the `/tmp` directory.
   ```
   cd /tmp
   ```
3. List all files in the directory, including hidden files.
   ```
   ls -la
   ```
4. Identify the ransomware script file.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Use the `ls -la` command to list all files in the `/tmp` directory.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for a file with a name that suggests it is related to encryption or cryptography.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: The ransomware script file is a hidden file.

levels.title: Exfiltration Remote Destination
levels.content: Analyze the script identified in the previous step to find the remote destination used to send files to the exfiltration server.
levels.solution:
1. SSH into the victim machine using the provided credentials.
   ```
   ssh cyrano@192.168.90.10
   ```
2. Navigate to the `/tmp` directory.
   ```
   cd /tmp
   ```
3. Read the contents of the ransomware script file.
   ```
   cat .crypt_agent
   ```
4. Identify the remote destination used for exfiltration by checking the `_exfil` function in the script.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Use the `cat` command to read the contents of the ransomware script file.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for the `_exfil` function in the script.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: The remote destination is specified as an argument to the `rsync` command in the `_exfil` function.
